strongest_bounded_proposition: The bounded packet does not establish slavery or an enslaved status in the sampled Olmec target at c. 500 BCE.
strongest_unsupported_proposition: Do not infer slavery from hierarchy, monumental labour, warfare, or slavery elsewhere in precontact America.
temporal_scope_precision: Bounded to cited evidence; sample interval is not itself slavery evidence.
inference_extent: No inference beyond stated target/evidence locus.
contrary_limiting_evidence: Cambridge's precontact synthesis distinguishes state labour obligations from slavery and cannot be projected automatically to Olmec society.
language_access_limitations: English-accessible packet only; non-English/non-digitized scholarship not exhaustively searched.

sources.title: The Oxford Handbook of the Olmecs

unresolved_issues: No target-specific c.500 BCE slavery evidence found within the source ladder.
